contenders.handicapper_notes: Chad Brown trainee gets the ideal rail draw on the Inner Turf oval where saving ground is paramount. Sea The Stars filly stayed on gamely at 1 3/8M and 1 3/16M at Saratoga and gets Flavien Prat back in the irons in her specialty distance wheelhouse.

Narrowly edged Mary Lois for the place spot when finishing strongly in a 1 3/16M MSW at Saratoga on Aug 22. Highly dependable late-running filly for Miguel Clement, but gives up tactical post position edge to the rail runner on this tight-turned course.

Suffered a nightmarish trip on turf debut at Colonial on Aug 28 when blocked along the rail until the 1/16th pole before flying late to just miss by a neck. Lands a massive rider upgrade to John Velazquez and represents a high-upside secondary threat.

Todd Pletcher-trained Siyouni filly ran fifth behind Stand The Rain and Mary Lois on Aug 22 after swinging seven wide into the lane. Eligible to move forward second off the layoff with Ricardo Santana Jr. retaining the mount.

Neil Drysdale shipper from Southern California has held her own against competitive maiden company at Santa Anita and Del Mar. Draws nicely inside in post 3 and gets Joel Rosario to provide patient handling over the ten furlongs.

French-bred filly makes her North American debut for Miguel Clement with Lasix added. Showed precocious ability when placed in Ireland as a juvenile and gets Javier Castellano from an advantageous low draw.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Sets the form standard after a sharp runner-up effort at Saratoga on Aug 12 earning a solid 67 speed figure. Possesses tactical forward positioning and fired a strong four-furlong bullet (49.49) at Belmont to prep for the extra furlong.

Suffered significant traffic trouble when checked sharply at the three-eighths pole in debut before surging home with late interest for third behind Under The Moon. By American Pharoah out of a Ghostzapper mare, she is bred to relish the seven-furlong trip and drilled a best-of-77 morning work (48.19) over the local surface.

Delivered an eye-catching late rush from well back while swinging six-wide to grab third in debut, posting the field top figure of 73. Steps up from 5 1/2 furlongs to seven panels which perfectly fits her swooping running style at generous morning-line odds.

Well-regarded first-time starter by Epicenter debuting for Jorge Abreu and Flavien Prat. Displays a five-furlong gate drill in 59.80 at Saratoga, though per master rules a three-point first-time starter penalty is applied facing rivals with proven high-level race experience.

Takes advantage of scratches to draw in from the also-eligible list. Improved substantially second out when grinding home for fourth in a quick Saratoga sprint, demonstrating useful tactical versatility for underneath exotic consideration.

Showed good gate speed in debut before encountering heavy bumping at the quarter pole and faltering. Draws well toward the inside and is eligible to clear early and dictate terms at an improved price for George Weaver and Junior Alvarado.

contenders.handicapper_notes: First-time starter for elite turf connections Chad Brown and Flavien Prat. Holds the critical 2YO race experience edge after a promising debut closing for second in a five-furlong turf sprint at Monmouth (Speed 101). Draws ideal low post with rail set out at 36 feet and figures to get a ground-saving midpack journey under Samuel Marin.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Top selection. Multiple graded stakes-placed router with proven 10-furlong staying power. Ran a competitive 2nd in the G3 Dinner Party and was a solid 2nd last out behind Starship Titan at Saratoga with a 100 speed figure. Tactical stalking style ('P') is ideally suited to the sweeping Belmont turf.

Dangerous front-runner coming off a wire-to-wire victory at Saratoga going 1 3/8 miles on August 22 with a 98 speed figure. Re-united with Hall of Famer John Velazquez. If allowed an uncontested rhythm around two turns, he could take them all the way.

Chad Brown trainee making his second start off a year-long layoff. Was G1-placed in the Belmont Derby and showed good late interest when 3rd behind A Bourbon For Toby at Saratoga on August 6. Expected to show major fitness progression second off the bench.

Designated Danger Horse. Proven marathon specialist turning back from a closing 3rd in the 1 1/2-mile Colonial Cup Stakes on September 7 with a 104 speed figure. Possesses high endurance and will be motoring home late if the front-runners duel.
